body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not always provide a minimum 12-month eligibility period for each child, as required by 98.21(a)(1). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide data on the extent to which CCDF providers charge families additional amounts above the required co-payment (including data on the size and frequency of such amounts), as required by 98.45(b)(5). (Plan Question 3.1.2eii) Overall Target Completion Date: 05/31/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 The Department of Social Services (DSS) collects data related to payments charged to families 12/31/2025 through the biennial Market Rate Survey. DSS will 12/31/2025 include additional questions to further data collection for additional information in regards to 3.1.2eii. Projected MRS vendor start date of October 2025. 2 The MRS survey is projected to be complete by end of December 2025. 12/31/2025 3 South Dakota could provide this information during our data analysis period in 2026. 05/31/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). PPlease note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through August 1, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not pay providers on a part-time or full-time basis or alternatively does not provide a justification that it is not a generally-accepted practice, as required by 98.45(m)(3). (Plan Question 4.4.2a) Overall Target Completion Date: 03/31/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Due to current system limitations in the legacy eligibility and enrollment system , the state is unable to pay child care providers prospectively. When CCA moves to the modern eligibility system, BEES, we will be able to accommodate prospective payments. DSS has submitted a waiver and received waiver approval as of 11/22/2024 for paying all provider types prospectively 4.4.1a. The modern eligibility system will also meet paying providers on a part- time or full-time basis 4.4.2a. Examples of levels are full time, part time, and least time. 12/31/2024 2 Design, Develop, and test functionality with IT team. 01/30/2026 3 Develop training materials and train staff on new IT system. 01/30/2026 4 Deploy IT functionality to process and track CCDF requirement. *Projected System go-live, and all other dates subject to change* 03/31/2026

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide sufficient grants or contracts for direct services for infants and toddlers, for children in underserved geographic areas, and for children with disabilities, as required by 98.30(b)(1). (Plan Question 4.5.1i) Overall Target Completion Date: 06/01/2025 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 After further guidance from OCC, DSS will update the contracted slots contracts and policies to meet 4.5.1i. Policy Updated 03/31/2025 2 Contracts Updated 05/30/2025 3 Updated Policy and Contracts in place. *Please note that these timelines could happen sooner than dates listed.
